title: Sparkly red car
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='carBody' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#ff5a5a'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#c81e1e'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='windowGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#bfeaff'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#5fa8d6'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill='#ffe066'>
    <path d='M18 20 l1.5 4 4 1.5 -4 1.5 -1.5 4 -1.5 -4 -4 -1.5 4 -1.5z'/>
    <path d='M82 16 l1.2 3.2 3.2 1.2 -3.2 1.2 -1.2 3.2 -1.2 -3.2 -3.2 -1.2 3.2 -1.2z'/>
    <path d='M88 56 l1.2 3.2 3.2 1.2 -3.2 1.2 -1.2 3.2 -1.2 -3.2 -3.2 -1.2 3.2 -1.2z'/>
    <path d='M12 62 l1.2 3.2 3.2 1.2 -3.2 1.2 -1.2 3.2 -1.2 -3.2 -3.2 -1.2 3.2 -1.2z'/>
    <path d='M50 8 l1 2.6 2.6 1 -2.6 1 -1 2.6 -1 -2.6 -2.6 -1 2.6 -1z'/>
    <path d='M30 78 l1 2.6 2.6 1 -2.6 1 -1 2.6 -1 -2.6 -2.6 -1 2.6 -1z' fill='#ffe066'/>
  </g>

  <!-- car body -->
  <path d='M10 62 Q10 52 20 52 L30 52 L40 38 Q42 35 46 35 L62 35 Q66 35 68 38 L78 52 L84 52 Q92 52 92 62 L92 68 Q92 72 88 72 L14 72 Q10 72 10 68 Z' fill='url(#carBody)' stroke='#ff8080' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <!-- windows -->
  <path d='M42 50 L47 40 Q48 38 50 38 L58 38 L58 50 Z' fill='url(#windowGrad)' stroke='#e0f6ff' stroke-width='1'/>
  <path d='M61 38 L66 38 Q68 38 69 40 L74 50 L61 50 Z' fill='url(#windowGrad)' stroke='#e0f6ff' stroke-width='1'/>

  <!-- door line -->
  <line x1='60' y1='52' x2='60' y2='70' stroke='#a01818' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <!-- wheels -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='72' r='11' fill='#3a2a4a' stroke='#6a5a7a' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='72' r='5' fill='#c0c0d0'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='72' r='11' fill='#3a2a4a' stroke='#6a5a7a' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='72' r='5' fill='#c0c0d0'/>

  <!-- headlight -->
  <circle cx='12' cy='60' r='3' fill='#fff3b0' stroke='#ffe066' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- taillight -->
  <rect x='89' y='58' width='3' height='6' rx='1.5' fill='#ffb0b0'/>
</svg>
